refreshToken.title: Flame Connect Refresh Token (manual fallback)
refreshToken.description: Normally use the guided sign-in above. This field remains available for tokens obtained with flameconnect-auth. Rotated tokens are stored in Homebridge storage.

tokenFile.title: Token File (advanced)
tokenFile.description: Optional absolute path for the persistent token file. Normally leave blank.

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Background Refresh Interval
pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to refresh fireplace state in the background. Default is 24 hours to stay conservative with the cloud API. HomeKit reads also refresh stale state on demand.

cacheSeconds.title: HomeKit Read Cache
cacheSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between on-demand cloud reads for one fireplace.

exposePower.title: Expose Fireplace Power
exposePower.description: Show the main fireplace power switch in HomeKit.

exposeFlames.title: Expose Flames and Brightness
exposeFlames.description: Show the flame-effect switch and brightness slider in HomeKit.

exposeHeater.title: Expose Heater Thermostat
exposeHeater.description: Show the heater as an off/heat thermostat with target-temperature control when supported. Flame Connect does not report measured room temperature, so HomeKit's current value mirrors the target.

exposeFlameSpeed.title: Expose Flame Speed
exposeFlameSpeed.description: Show a five-step HomeKit speed slider. 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100% correspond to Flame Connect speeds 1 through 5.

exposeEcoMode.title: Expose Eco Mode
exposeEcoMode.description: Show one Eco Mode switch when advanced heat is supported. Off selects Normal mode without changing whether the thermostat is on.

exposeFanOnly.title: Expose Fan Only
exposeFanOnly.description: Show Fan Only when the fireplace reports support. Turning it off stops the fan and will not unexpectedly start heat.

exposeTurboBoost.title: Expose Turbo Boost
exposeTurboBoost.description: Show a single timed Turbo Boost switch when the fireplace reports Power Boost support.

turboBoostMinutes.title: Turbo Boost Duration
turboBoostMinutes.description: Number of minutes requested when Turbo Boost is turned on.

exposeMediaLight.title: Expose Media Bed
exposeMediaLight.description: Show the media-light switch in HomeKit.

exposeOverheadLight.title: Expose Media Accent
exposeOverheadLight.description: Show the overhead-light switch in HomeKit.

exposeLogs.title: Expose Logs
exposeLogs.description: Show the log or ember effect with on/off, color, and brightness controls when supported.

powerName.title: Fireplace control name
powerName.description: Applied when this setting changes and Homebridge restarts. Later Apple Home renames are preserved.

advancedControls.title: Expose Advanced Switches
advancedControls.description: Also expose Pulsating Effect and Ambient Sensor as switches.
